title: Field Validator
prompt:
Write `validateField(name, value)` that RETURNS `null` when valid or an error-message string when not:

- `name` — required, 2–40 characters after trim
- `email` — must contain `@` with non-empty parts on both sides
- `age` — a number 16–120 inclusive (accept numeric strings)

Any other field name returns `null`.

tests.name: name rules
tests.hint: const v = value.trim(); check v.length >= 2 && v.length <= 40.

tests.name: email rules
tests.hint: Split on '@' — exactly one @, both sides non-empty.

tests.name: age rules
tests.hint: Number(value) then Number.isFinite + range check; NaN fails the finite check for you.
